articles.summary: Comparable Net Sales Growth in Third Quarter and Early Stages of Fourth Quarter IRVINE, Calif. --(BUSINESS WIRE)--Dec. 3, 2025-- Tilly’s, Inc. (NYSE: TLYS, the "Company") today announced financial results for the third quarter of fiscal 2025 ended November 1, 2025 .
articles.title: Tilly's, Inc. Exceeds Fiscal 2025 Third Quarter Earnings Outlook
